title: Describing Sudden Events: amint, rövid idő alatt, hirtelen

sections.title: Describing sudden and overwhelming events
sections.content: Accounts of a battle use phrases for sudden change: *amint* ('as soon as', starting a clause like *amikor*), *rövid idő alatt* ('in a short time') and *hirtelen* ('suddenly'). *Amint* is new here.

items.spanish: Amint megindult a magyar lovasroham, már pusztító ágyútűzbe ütközött.
items.english: As soon as the Hungarian cavalry charge began, it ran into devastating cannon fire.

items.spanish: Rövid idő alatt a magyar hadrend felbomlott a hatalmas oszmán túlerővel szemben.
items.english: Within a short time, the Hungarian battle line collapsed against overwhelming Ottoman superior numbers.

items.spanish: Tomori Pál kalocsai érsek, a sereg fővezére, a csatában elesett.
items.english: Pál Tomori, archbishop of Kalocsa and commander-in-chief of the army, was killed in the battle.
